createWorkspace.title: Create a workspace

overview.title: Overview
overview.activityEmptyBody: Once agents run in this workspace, their latest executions appear here with status, duration and estimated cost — each one linked to its trace.
overview.detailsError: Workspace details are unavailable right now.

agents.description: Agents combine instructions, a model and the tools they're allowed to use.

executions.emptyBody: This page will list executions with filters by agent, status and date, and open each trace step by step.

tools.emptyBody: This page will list built-in and custom tools, their JSON schema and which agents may use them, with a controlled test run.

workflows.emptyBody: This page will hold the visual editor for multi-step workflows and the live view of their runs.
